author: Germ0nEmp1re
body: Hello my name is username germ0nemp1re and I was banned for flying over 1 year ago. I really don't know any other reason on why I should have it lifted other than that what I did was wrong. I'm terribly sorry for flying on Nebula and if this gets lifted I promise that I won't commit anything hacking related. It's been a real bummer not being able to play on this server especially not participating in the fight to destroy the enemy's obsidian. But in conclusion I can't say enough how sorry I am and I promise that this will never happen again.
